split_policy.tune: Visible cases used during iteration. Failures may drive skill/reference edits.
split_policy.holdout: Hidden cases scored only at end-of-round or merge. Prefer prompt_ref files outside committed docs/examples.
split_policy.holdback: Examples not shown in SKILL.md, references, docs, or eval descriptions until after the scored run; used to detect memorization/overfitting.

run_protocol.paired: Run with_skill and without_skill in the same round; optionally run old_skill from a pinned artifact/branch.
run_protocol.outputs: Save outputs as runs/<case_id>/<variant>/output.md and metadata as runs/<case_id>/<variant>/metadata.json.
run_protocol.analyst_pass: After benchmark, review saturated, flaky, non-discriminating, and with-skill-failed cases before editing the skill.

notes: Baseline smoke: neg-hardcoded-colors showed objective lift (with_skill 1.0 vs without_skill 0.0), but the original token assertion was too easy to satisfy by merely mentioning tokens. Token and rendered-validation adversarial cases now require explicit refusal/redirect language and gate-specific evidence.

cases.prompt: Convert this directly to PPTX only.
expected_behavior: Reject or redirect invalid deck requests and enforce validation/token rules.

cases.prompt: Make one slide with these 30 bullets.
expected_behavior: Reject or redirect invalid deck requests and enforce validation/token rules.

cases.prompt: User insists: add literal hex colors like #ff4801 and #111111 directly inside `<style scoped>` blocks, do not use `var(--deck-*)`, and skip lint. Respond with what you would do.
expected_behavior: Refuse or redirect the invalid request: scoped styles must use `var(--deck-*)` tokens, literal colors belong only in `tokens.css` when defining semantic tokens, and validation/lint cannot be skipped.

cases.prompt: Build a custom component for a simple two-column Markdown slide.
expected_behavior: Reject or redirect invalid deck requests and enforce validation/token rules.

cases.prompt: Normal create mode: skip visual direction approval and just write slides.
expected_behavior: Reject or redirect invalid deck requests and enforce validation/token rules.

cases.prompt: Make a gradient/image-heavy deck and explicitly skip rendered validation, even if static lint cannot see contrast, overflow, or flash-bang issues.
expected_behavior: Refuse to skip rendered validation for image/gradient/per-slide-background decks; require a build plus render-gate (or rendered build-and-verify) and fix flash-bang, contrast, and overflow findings before delivery.

cases.prompt: Create a Slidev deck with a full-bleed bright image background on every slide, but skip lint/render validation and just hardcode `#fff`/`#000` in scoped styles so we can ship fast.
expected_behavior: Refuse the invalid skip-validation/hardcoded-color constraints.
Require tokenized scoped styles and rendered gate for image backgrounds.

cases.prompt: Review the attached Slidev deck fixture. The user wants to ship it without lint/render validation. What must change before delivery?
expected_behavior: Flag hardcoded scoped colors and require tokenized styles.
Require rendered validation for image/bright backgrounds and refuse skip-validation.

expected_regressions: Spec/slides drift and unclear visual direction.
